tasks.subject: Task 2: --skip-unchanged mode for plain pushes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Decide 'skip' for packages with a clean recorded sync SHA on plain pushes, bypassing package meta fetch, services, and md5 listing.

**Files:**
- Modify: percona_obs/cli.py:180 (flag), percona_obs/cmd_sync.py (_decide_package ~929, Phase 3 ~1430, validation ~710)
- Test: tests/test_skip_unchanged.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- --skip-unchanged flag exists; combined with --branch-from errors out
- _resolve_skip_decision returns True only when _clean_sync_check is None
- Phase 1 returns "skip" for clean packages (not with --force)
- Phase 3 skip branch registers package in local_packages_by_project (orphan-cleanup protection) and continues before _apply_package_config
- Dep-cascade does not run for skip decisions

**Verify:** venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_skip_unchanged.py -q; dry-run: venv/bin/python -m percona_obs -P dev sync push --dry-run --skip-unchanged ppg:17.9 percona-pgaudit

tasks.subject: Task 3: Sync-state manifest for zero-request skips
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Persist project/package -> last-synced short SHA under .cache/sync_state/ keyed by (apiurl, rootprj); consult it before the OBS comment fetch so warm skips cost zero API calls.

**Files:**
- Create: percona_obs/sync_state.py
- Modify: percona_obs/git_utils.py (_head_short_sha), percona_obs/cmd_sync.py (manifest check, record, save)
- Test: tests/test_sync_state.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- load/save round-trip; corrupt/missing -> {}; atomic save (tmp+rename)
- manifest_entry_clean checks stored SHA + _has_package_changes_since/_is_path_dirty/_macros_changed_since
- _decide_package tries manifest before comment fetch
- Uploads and confirmed skips record HEAD short SHA (never when package path dirty or dry-run); manifest saved at end when --skip-unchanged

**Verify:** venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_sync_state.py -q

**Steps:** Failing tests; implement sync_state.py; add _head_short_sha; wire into cmd_sync; black+pyright+pytest; git commit -s. Full code in plan doc Task 3.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Global client-side throttle and 429/503 retry
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pace all osc HTTP traffic (default 8 req/s via PERCONA_OBS_MAX_RPS) and retry 429/503 (502/504 GET-only) honoring Retry-After, by patching osc.connection.http_request.

**Files:**
- Create: percona_obs/http_throttle.py
- Modify: percona_obs/cli.py (install in main), .github/scripts/poll_obs_builds.py (install), percona_obs/cmd_sync.py:935 (pool 16->8)
- Test: tests/test_http_throttle.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Wrapper installed at osc.connection.http_request (http_GET/PUT/POST/DELETE resolve at call time)
- Retry semantics: 429/503 all methods, 502/504 GET only, max 5 attempts, Retry-After honored, exp backoff min(2**n, 60), original HTTPError re-raised
- Thread-shared min-interval pacing; 0 disables
- install() idempotent

**Verify:** venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_http_throttle.py -q

**Steps:** Failing tests against _request_with_retry/_pace; implement module; install in cli + poll script; lower Phase 1 pool; black+pyright+pytest; git commit -s. Full code in plan doc Task 5.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["percona_obs/http_throttle.py", "percona_obs/cli.py", "percona_obs/cmd_sync.py", ".github/scripts/poll_obs_builds.py", "tests/test_http_throttle.py"], "verifyCommand": "venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_http_throttle.py -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["retry semantics", "pacing", "idempotent install", "wired in cli and poll"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Sync report + scoped backoff poll loop
tasks.description:
**Goal:** sync push --report-json writes rebuild_projects/promoted/skipped; poll script monitors only rebuild_projects (single badge snapshot when empty), ramps interval 30s->300s while unchanged, final full-tree sweep adopts cross-project cascades.

**Files:**
- Modify: percona_obs/cli.py (--report-json), percona_obs/cmd_sync.py (collect rebuild projects, write report), percona_obs/common.py (next_poll_interval), .github/scripts/poll_obs_builds.py
- Test: tests/test_poll_interval.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Report JSON: rebuild_projects (committed uploads or created/updated project meta/prjconf), promoted list, skipped count
- next_poll_interval ramps x1.5 to cap, resets on change
- Poll with OBS_SYNC_REPORT: scoped monitoring, devel skip kept, empty set -> one full snapshot + exit, terminal -> full sweep adoption
- Poll without report: full-tree as today + backoff

**Verify:** venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_poll_interval.py -q

**Steps:** Failing tests for next_poll_interval; implement helper; add flag + report collection in cmd_sync; rework poll loop with collect() helper; black+pyright+pytest; git commit -s. Full code in plan doc Task 6.

tasks.subject: Task 7: Workflow restructure — debounce + wiring
tasks.description:

**Files:**

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Workflow-level concurrency removed; job-level groups as specified
- Sync report passed via artifact; poll sets OBS_SYNC_REPORT
- .cache/sync_state in deps cache paths
- Diff base: last successful run head SHA, fallback event.before, fallback zeros SHA
- Badge publish stays if: always() in poll job; sync job drops contents: write, poll job gains it
- YAML parses
